_note: Impact spec v2 for the trace-verified runner (runner/README.md, 'impact-spec v2'). SCAFFOLD: the live-verification pass must add fork, tokens, holders, in_scope, views, invariants and probes from verified sources and the pinned block, then run gen_spec.py --self-check. Until then gen_spec.py refuses this spec and the runner cannot judge aave-v4 PoCs. Only Medium and Low findings are filed from this task at launch, so severity.max is medium.
pending_verification: fork: chain_id, pinned block, block hash and timestamp

tokens: the in-scope reserves' underlying assets with USD prices at the block, capital tokens and caps (flash-loanable liquidity); Aave-issued tokens (aTokens / debt or share tokens) with supply views
holders: every value-holding Aave V4 contract (hubs, spokes, treasury) as custody; victim suppliers with claim views and withdraw probes
in_scope: verified addresses, implementations and ABIs
views and invariants: total backing >= total debt per reserve (solvency), supply/borrow index accounting (accounting)
attacker_claims: supply positions (+1) and debt positions (-1) per reserve, so borrowing is never counted as theft
price_feeds: oracle feeds and realistic bounds; trusted_actions: routine keeper actions if needed
benign_entry_points: liquidations; known_issues: prior audit findings
limits: max_warp_s / max_roll from Aave V4's real horizons (interest accrual, any cooldowns), with horizon_basis
